verdict.rationale: ImageMagick is a locally run image-processing CLI and library with no hosted service, accounts, or authenticated API, so issuing scoped API credentials is a category error for this kind of product. Its security policies (Open/Limited/Secure/Websafe, policy.xml coder restrictions) restrict what the binary may do. They are not issuable credentials, so they do not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
